import asyncio, json, os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from igel import Igel
from igel.servers import fastapi_server
from fastapi import HTTPException
from igel.constants import Constants
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d); r=p/'results'; Igel.results_path=r; Igel.default_model_path=r/'model.joblib'; Igel.description_file=r/'description.json'; Igel.prediction_file=r/'pred.csv'; Igel.evaluation_file=r/'evaluation.json'
 data=pd.DataFrame({'a':[1,2,3,4,5,6], 'alias':[1,2,3,4,5,6], 'b':[6,5,4,3,2,1], 'y':[2,4,6,8,10,12], 'z':[3,6,9,12,15,18]}); data.to_csv(p/'train.csv',index=False)
 cfg={'dataset':{'features':{'include':['a','alias','b'],'drop_duplicate':True}},'model':{'type':'regression','algorithm':'LinearRegression'},'target':['y','z']}; (p/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps(cfg))
 Igel(cmd='fit',data_path=str(p/'train.csv'),yaml_path=str(p/'config.json'))
 data[['b','alias','y','z']].to_csv(p/'eval.csv',index=False)
 Igel(cmd='evaluate',data_path=str(p/'eval.csv'),model_path=r/'model.joblib',description_file=r/'description.json')
 os.environ[Constants.model_results_path]=str(r)
 try: asyncio.run(fastapi_server.predict({'b':[1,2]}))
 except HTTPException as e: assert e.status_code==400 and 'a' in e.detail; print('HTTP schema failure:',e.detail)
 else: raise AssertionError('HTTP validation failed')
 cfg['model']={'type':'clustering','algorithm':'KMeans','arguments':{'n_clusters':2,'random_state':0}}; cfg['target']=None; data[['a','alias','b']].to_csv(p/'cluster.csv',index=False); (p/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps(cfg))
 Igel(cmd='fit',data_path=str(p/'cluster.csv'),yaml_path=str(p/'config.json'))
 Igel(cmd='evaluate',data_path=str(p/'cluster.csv'),model_path=r/'model.joblib',description_file=r/'description.json')
 print('multi-target, HTTP validation, and clustering checks passed')
